senses.gloss: f. (חָמַר I) heavy, weighty, important; strict, severe, stringent, restrictive.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:4">Kel. I, 4</cite> <he>ח׳ שבכולם וכ׳</he> the most stringent of all are the laws concerning corpses.—<he>איסור ח׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01405"><he>אִיסּוּר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 50a:8">Snh. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>שריפה ח׳ וכ׳</he> death by burning is a severer punishment than &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:4">Ib. IX, 4</cite>, a. e. <he>נידון בח׳</he> he suffers the severer penalty of the two.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:1">Ab. II, 1</cite> <he>כבחמורה</he> as in the observance of a difficult commandment (requiring self-denial); a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲמוּרִים</he>, <he>חֲמוּרִין</he>, f. <he>חֲמוּרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:5">Ḥull. XII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ top <he>חֲמוּרוֹתָיו של וכ׳</he> (not <he>חומר׳</he>) the heaviest sins that Jeroboam committed.—<he>דורשי חֲמוּרוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="H00391"><he>חוֹמֶר</he> II</cite>. <he>קלים וחֲמוּרִים</he>, v. <cite ref="H00390"><he>חוֹמֶר</he> I</cite>.
